messages:
jen-support: ACMEcorp (acct-ACME-zz) reporting 429 surge in reserved-42 pool since 07:10 UTC. customer says their chat app is timing out.

maria-oncall: checking. any sample response headers? is it per-tenant or pool-wide?

jen-support: sample curl (sanitized):

````
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer acct-ACME-zz" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://inference.redwood.example/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hey","max_tokens":32}'

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60/min
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1717501200

{"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"tenant rate window exceeded"}
````

alex-infra: saw similar alerts on reserved-42. Quick grep of tenant row shows rate_denom="hour" even though legacy plan had minute windows. I think migration defaulted to hour for custom overrides.

alex-infra: router log excerpt:
```
[07:12:03] router=reserved-42 tenant=ACME auth=k tenant_rate=1 denom=hour applied=1
[07:12:03] quota-service tenant=ACME configured_denom=hour legacy_flag=true
[07:12:03] router reserved-42 -> 429 tenant=ACME
```

maria-oncall: can we apply a temporary override to restore minute denom while we patch the migration?

alex-infra: yes. admin API:

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://internal-api/admin/tenants/ACME/overrides \n  -d '{"rate_denom":"minute","rate_limit":300,"note":"emergency - restore legacy burst window"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: fix/migration-denom-bug -> infra (sha: f0e1d2c)

alex-infra: applied override at 07:20 UTC. monitoring: pre-fix 429s ~800/min for tenant; 5m after override 429s ~3/min. Customer confirms success.

eva-cs: customer relieved. They want a follow-up timeline and a postmortem.

maria-oncall: root cause: migration script's loop used incorrect index when reading legacy override rows, setting global denom instead of preserving per-tenant denom. Plan: patch script, add unit test and db sanity check, run conversion in batches. Also add a migration verifier to CI.

alex-infra: opening PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/512 - includes test and a safe flag. Will run a dry-run on staging then roll out. ETA for full sweep: 3h if staging dry-run clean.

jen-support: updating INC-9382 with notes and customer comms. I'll keep channel posted.

maria-oncall: after sweep, add a scheduler to revalidate tenant quotas nightly for 7 days.

jen-support: thanks all :purple_heart:
